answer_1.quote: We apply G2LC to two tasks: keyword-to-sentence generation and unsupervised paraphrase generation.
answer_1.outputs: Generated sentences that satisfy keyword constraints and paraphrased sentences

answer_2.quote: The language fluency of generated target sentences is measured by negative log-likelihood (NLL) loss... we evaluate the performance of the paraphrasing generation model by BLEU... iBLEU... ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-2.

answer_4.quote: For human evaluation, we asked 6 data graders to help us evaluate the language fluency for each target sentence... We sampled 300 sentences ... asked 6 data graders to judge the relevance score and fluent score of these sentences.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each generated sentence on fluency (0 to 1) and relevance (0 to 1).
